findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 1 section(s) carry more than 60 words outside their lists and tables: "The town it serves" (74 words).
findings.fix: A section says one thing in 60 words at most: a heading, one or two short sentences, and the facts as a list or a table. A card says its point in about 25 words. Cut, never shrink the type.

findings.message: 2 block(s) of running, list or table text at 14-15px: "Photographs on this page are illustrativ" 15px; "Concept preview. Enquiries only, not a b" 15px (in the footer).
findings.fix: Running text, lists and tables 16px or more on desktop and 15px on a phone, on dark grounds as well; under a display heading 18px or more; set it beside the picture it describes, never pushed to the far edge. Only captions and the footer's legal line may be smaller.

findings.message: 3 grounds on the page, by the screens they cover: #0d1f1e (the page, 2.87 screens); #cddce3 (div.seg-ground, 2.04 screens); #233634 (div.goods__disc, 0.33 screens).
findings.fix: One ground and one surface tone a step from it, and no tint between them. The ink grounds a band at most (the footer and one section), and so do a dealt field and the accent (one section each); a scene's veil or band takes one of these, never a tone sampled from its photograph, unless its own sheet asks for one (then that is the page's band). Every other section, panel and card takes one of these, a sheet in another colour (a white receipt on grey) is set on the section ground, and a piece of work keeps its own colours inside its picture.

findings.message: 3 sections are built round one picture: "THE SHO" (under its heading); "Clubs, schools and players." (in columns under its heading); "visit" (no heading).
findings.fix: Give each section the structure its content asks for, and never one structure three times: a list as a list across the width, a split with a picture, cards in a row, a statement alone, a table, a gallery, a working tool. Change what the section holds, the heading's place and the columns from one to the next (critique.md, pass 9).

findings.message: The footer links to 1 other site, not the client's own: "The listing" (threebestrated.in).
findings.fix: The footer links to the client's own: its sections and pages, the contact, the map, its own profiles, the legal pages and the Image credits. A product it works with or a reference it follows is named in a line of type where the page needs it, never a link column to another company's site.

findings.message: 1 element(s) run into the right side of the screen at rest while the page keeps a 43px margin: a box ("Illustrative photograph - equipment deta", 808px wide) touches the right edge, screen 1.
findings.fix: A picture or a field flush with one side of the screen reads as running out of the page. Keep it inside the margins, or run it from edge to edge; a split whose picture fills its half to the edge is a choice to defend in one sentence.
